messages:
sarah-csm: Heads-up — Orion's onboarding push doubled embeddings calls last week. Can we run a short cost-health workshop before their QBR? Main goals: confirm 30/60-day forecast, propose throttle/retainer options, capture enablement action items and customer feedback.

miguel-finops: On it. Pulled a 7-day snapshot: embeddings avg ~1.1M tokens/day, spike to 2.4M tokens on 03/12 after their batch import. If trend continues they'll exhaust the monthly retainer next week. I can build a 4-scenario forecast (baseline / +25% / +50% / cache-on) and recommend guardrails.

alex-csm: +1. Customer asked for per-feature cost breakdown (embeds vs generative routes) in the deck — can we surface that from the console?

sam-pe: I can run a quick prompt-trimming experiment to see if we can reduce tokens without hurting quality. Will run 100 evals and share delta by EOD.

billing-bot: Billing alert: ORION (acct_54321) reached 85% of monthly retainer. Next threshold (100%) will trigger throttle at 01:00 UTC.

sarah-csm: Thanks. Action items: miguel -> forecast + model/quantization recs; sam -> trimming eval + examples; alex -> schedule a 30m workshop with Orion (customer-facing) and invite their eng lead; I'll assemble a slide deck with cost levers. @miguel can you paste the raw forecast here when ready?

miguel-finops: Pasting quick forecast snapshot for thread:
```
7-day baseline: 1.1M avg/day => est 33M/month
+25% growth => 41.25M/month
+50% growth => 49.5M/month
Cache-on scenario => ~22M/month (rough)
Estimated cost delta (embeddings): baseline ~$12K/mo, +50% ~$18K/mo, cache-on ~$7.5K/mo
Recommended short-term: enable prefix caching on /v1/embeddings, set per-route max_tokens to 2048 where feasible, apply 8-bit quant for heavy-batch workers (20-30% cost reduction).
```

alex-csm: Invite sent for Mon 10:00am PT. Customer also asked for two "what-if" rows in the slide: 50% growth and cache-enabled. Can you include those numbers, miguel?

sam-pe: Quick results from trimming run: removed verbose onboarding headers from 250 samples -> avg tokens per call down 18%, human eval on 100 samples shows negligible quality regression (NPS-style thumbs up 88/100). I'll attach 3 before/after examples to the deck.

sarah-csm: Perfect. We'll present: 1) snapshot & spike root cause, 2) forecast scenarios, 3) cost levers (cache, batching, quant, trim), 4) tradeoffs and recommended guardrails, 5) enablement next steps + feedback capture.

miguel-finops: I'll also create three automated alerts: 70% usage (informational), 85% (CS + billing ping), 100% (auto-throttle + ops page). Adding a temporary guardrail policy for Orion today.

alex-csm: Customer asked for a recurring weekly cost digest — added to the enablement backlog and flagged as prioritization-high.

sarah-csm: Great coordination. I'll ship a 6-slide deck + 1-pager with recommended config changes and open questions for the workshop. Sam/miguel: please drop your artifacts in this thread before EOD so I can finalize. Thanks! :thumbsup:
